Splash takes only Hugging Face repo ids for --model, so the harness links the model folder's files into a Hub-cache-shaped snapshot in {state} (nace-local/... is a local name, not a Hub repo; the revision is the SHA-1 of that name) and points HF_HUB_CACHE there; with --offline and a 40-hex --revision it asks the Hub for nothing. The MTP head and the drafter folder are not linked (Splash never reads MTP heads). Its DFlash2 drafter for this model, incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2 (the one Kapitsa reads), is named as a local directory with --draft-model, so a missing drafter fails the run instead of starting a download. Otherwise Splash's own defaults: DFlash2 speculation, always on (one draft pass proposes a 7-token chain, verified exactly; on this mixture of experts a verify budget learned over earlier cycles picks the rows, --verify-rows auto, hence the three extra warm-up decodes), INT8 KV, FP32 recurrent state, the SSD prefix cache at its automatic quota (temporary files, gone at exit). --expert-memory off keeps every routed expert resident (1.4.0 can stream experts from the SSD; its automatic setting also loads them all where memory holds them, as here). --max-context 32K like the other engines; --language-only (text only, no vision preparation); --idle-release off (by default an idle server frees its weights after 10 minutes); --no-webui. Inherited SPLASH_* variables (API key, port, reasoning defaults) are cleared.
